target.topology: one writable primary, persistent replicas and exactly three Sentinel voters

authority: PostgreSQL remains the only transactional authority; Valkey contains rebuildable coordination, cache and at-most-once Pub/Sub state only.

command_groups.semantics: Bounded-TTL cache and idempotency keys. SET EX NX is an atomic first-writer claim; SET EX refreshes a rebuildable value.
command_groups.failover_expectation: Reconnect through Sentinel. Callers must use idempotent retry after an ambiguous acknowledged write; PostgreSQL or the originating event remains authoritative.

command_groups.semantics: Small rebuildable field maps with an explicit expiration. No hash is a source of record.
command_groups.failover_expectation: Reconnect through Sentinel and rebuild from PostgreSQL or upstream events when the update result is ambiguous.

clients: ioredis publisher plus duplicated subscriber connection
command_groups.semantics: At-most-once cross-instance notification fanout. Pub/Sub is not a durable event log and messages can be lost during disconnect or failover.
command_groups.failover_expectation: Publisher and subscriber reconnect through Sentinel; clients recover durable user-visible events through the PostgreSQL-backed replay cursor rather than expecting Pub/Sub replay.

command_groups.owner: Platform data service and client libraries
command_groups.semantics: Authenticate data and Sentinel connections independently, discover the elected primary, inspect role/offset during acceptance and close connections cleanly.
command_groups.failover_expectation: Exactly three Sentinel voters must elect a different writable primary within a bounded interval; clients must rediscover it without a direct primary address.

integration_gates.scope: Three persistent Valkey data nodes, three Sentinel voters, data canaries and Pub/Sub before and after elected-primary loss.
success_criteria: Pub/Sub works before and after failover

integration_gates.scope: Use exact pinned component versions against one Sentinel topology without guessing their internal queue or PSRPC command surface.
success_criteria: Egress, Ingress and SIP requests traverse shared Redis

integration_gates.scope: Tinode v0.25.3 uses PostgreSQL, S3 and its native three-node ring in the approved architecture; no Valkey command dependency is configured.
success_criteria: no Redis or Valkey endpoint is required by the Tinode deployment contract
